description:
During the turn before yours, cast Teferi's Time Twist by paying {1}{U}, exiling Barren Glory until the next end step.
Cast Kaervek's Spite by paying {B}{B}{B}, discarding your hand, and sacrificing all permanents, causing target player to lose 5 life.
At the beginning of your the next end step, Teferi's Time Twist triggers, returning Barren Glory from exile to the battlefield.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.
